Q1 Headcount and wages
How many people did HGC employ, and why did wages rise from FY2025?

We averaged 91 people per regular payday in FY2025 and about 96 in FY2026: Alder Point and Tideflats added crews. There was no general raise; five people had individual rate changes effective December 22, 2025.
Q2 The June 26 bonus run
What was the June 26, 2026 bonus payroll?
Project-completion bonuses of $55,500.00 for 6 superintendents and project managers on Harbor Ridge Commons and the Northgate library, approved by the President and CEO on June 19, 2026.
Q3 Shared deposit account
Two employees are paid into the same bank account. Who are they and why?

Xavier Baptiste (E-1044) and Alicia Baptiste (E-1051), both journeyman carpenters, are married and asked to be paid into their joint account. Both direct deposit forms are signed and in their personnel files with their I-9s and W-4s, and they work on different jobs under different superintendents.
Q4 Rate approvals
Who approves a pay rate change, and were all the FY2026 changes approved?

The Chief Financial Officer approves field and estimating rates and the President and CEO approves office salaries, on a signed personnel action form before payroll enters the change. Renata Salazar enters every change. Her own increase to $98,000.00 was agreed in her review with the President and CEO, but the form was not signed before she entered it.
Q5 Leavers
How is someone who leaves removed from payroll?
The superintendent or manager sends the last day worked; payroll pays the final check on the next regular payday and inactivates the employee the same day. Six people left in FY2026.
Q6 Accrued wages
What is accrued for wages at June 30?

Wages earned from June 22 to 30 and paid on July 10: seven of the nine working days for hourly crews and seven of ten for salaried staff. Employer payroll taxes are expensed when the payroll is paid, so none is accrued.
Q7 L&I deduction
How does the payroll system work out the L&I employee share?
On the hours payroll sends to the rate: regular hours plus time and a half for overtime, the same premium hours we use for job costing.
Q8 Forms 941
Were all four Forms 941 filed on time, and was any amended?
Yes. The payroll system files them and I sign them; none was amended. The payroll system makes the deposits on the semiweekly schedule.
